recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑之間的骨髓幾乎全被淡粉色、紡錘細胞為主的纖維化間質取代，其中散布許多深染的小上皮細胞巢，看不到正常造血與脂肪結構，是轉移癌廣泛取代骨髓的低倍型態。
features: Low-power view: extensive replacement of marrow spaces between bone trabeculae by pale fibrous (desmoplastic) stroma
Numerous small, irregular, darker-staining nests and cords of epithelial cells distributed throughout the stroma
Some nests with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, suggesting squamous differentiation
Near-total loss of normal hematopoietic tissue and fat cells in the field
Thin bone trabeculae without marked new bone formation
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows near-complete replacement of the intertrabecular spaces by a pale desmoplastic stroma. Innumerable small, irregular nests and cords of epithelial cells, some with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, are dispersed throughout the fibrotic stroma, and normal hematopoietic marrow is not identified in this field. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. In the clinical context, the findings are consistent with extensive metastatic carcinoma, compatible with squamous cell carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis or other fibrotic myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis shows streaming atypical megakaryocyte clusters and dilated sinuses rather than cohesive nests of cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic lobular breast or signet-ring carcinoma
ddx.vs: These infiltrate as single files or dispersed single cells that are easy to miss, rather than discrete nests with eosinophilic squamoid cytoplasm.
Mast cell aggregates are composed of spindle to oval cells with clear cytoplasm that are CD117/tryptase positive and cytokeratin negative.
